cases.question: Record that Bob is off sick this week; his branch's consultations will be down.
expected_behavior: The agent records the fact at once with add_context, attached to the metric it concerns
The agent confirms what was recorded by name and says it was stored owners-only
cases.ground_truth: A durable fact about the business stated by the person: add_context, immediately.

cases.question: We launched the new pricing page on Tuesday, make sure the assistant knows that when it looks at conversion.
expected_behavior: The agent writes the launch back with add_context against the conversion metric
The agent does not run an analysis the person did not ask for

cases.question: I think marketing spend is driving sign-ups. Can you register that as a driver relationship in KPI Tree?
expected_behavior: The agent verifies with verify_driver_relationship first
If refuted the agent does not assert it; otherwise it registers it with propose_context_hypothesis and says it observes until verified
The agent never states an unverified causal relationship as fact

cases.question: That note about the warehouse outage in KPI Tree is wrong, it was the courier not the warehouse. Fix it.
expected_behavior: The agent retracts the wrong item with retract_context_item and records the corrected fact with add_context

cases.question: Nobody owns the Refund Rate metric. Can you make Priya responsible for it?
expected_behavior: The agent resolves the person with list_users and reads the current RACI with get_metric before writing
The agent sends the merged full list with update_metric, or explains that the editor role is needed

cases.question: Pull what we learned from the #ops Slack channel into KPI Tree.
expected_behavior: The agent uses ingest_context_from_source where the person is an admin, and otherwise records the facts with add_context

cases.question: Approve the budget approval the workflow raised for me yesterday.
expected_behavior: The agent resolves the approval with resolve_approval_task as approved, after confirming which task
The agent says plainly if the person is not the assigned approver rather than retrying another verb

cases.question: Create a task for Sam to chase the Leeds pipeline; we agreed it in the review.
expected_behavior: The agent creates the task with create_task against the metric it concerns, assigned to Sam, since the person has asked for it
The agent confirms what was created by name
